house.description: Community Mediation Minnesota grant funding provided to administer a statewide family mediation pilot program, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Children and Families Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to children, youth, and families; appropriating money for a grant to Community Mediation Minnesota to administer a statewide family mediation pilot program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; STATEWIDE FAMILY MEDIATION PILOT PROGRAM. +]

[+(a) $3,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Community Mediation Minnesota to administer a statewide family mediation pilot program to provide support to grandparents and families. This is a onetime appropriation. +]

[+(b) The grant money must be used to: +]

[+(1) provide family dispute resolution services; +]

[+(2) increase awareness of and access to family dispute resolution services statewide; +]

[+(3) provide alternative dispute resolution services, including but not limited to family reconnection coaching, mediation, and navigation services; +]

[+(4) partner with culturally specific dispute resolution programs to provide training and assistance with virtual and in-person mediation services; +]

[+(5) increase the number of mediators on the family mediator roster; +]

[+(6) increase competency of mediators on the family mediator roster; +]

[+(7) integrate mediation services with navigation and resource connection services, legal assistance, and court services programs; +]

[+(8) develop and administer evaluation tools to design, modify, and replicate effective program outcomes; and +]

[+(9) provide for necessary administrative expenses. +]
additions: APPROPRIATION; STATEWIDE FAMILY MEDIATION PILOT PROGRAM.

(a) $3,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Community Mediation Minnesota to administer a statewide family mediation pilot program to provide support to grandparents and families. This is a onetime appropriation.
(b) The grant money must be used to:
(1) provide family dispute resolution services;
(2) increase awareness of and access to family dispute resolution services statewide;
(3) provide alternative dispute resolution services, including but not limited to family reconnection coaching, mediation, and navigation services;
(4) partner with culturally specific dispute resolution programs to provide training and assistance with virtual and in-person mediation services;
(5) increase the number of mediators on the family mediator roster;
(6) increase competency of mediators on the family mediator roster;
(7) integrate mediation services with navigation and resource connection services, legal assistance, and court services programs;
(8) develop and administer evaluation tools to design, modify, and replicate effective program outcomes; and
(9) provide for necessary administrative expenses.
